C:S1.1.text: The Insulated Panels segment covers insulated panels, structural frames, and metal facades. The Insulation segment covers rigid insulation boards, building-series insulation, and engineered timber systems.

C:S2.1.text: Listings include Quadcore wall and roof sandwich panels with polyisocyanurate (PIR) foam cores, cold-store panels, and PIR insulation boards with foil or glass-tissue facings.

C:S3.1.text: Kingspan Insulation describes itself as a maker of premium rigid insulation and insulated systems for building fabric and services. Its applications include cavity walls, solid walls, timber and steel framing, and roofing.

C:S4.1.text: The group also sells roofing and waterproofing, light and air products, solar and renewables, access floors, and water and energy products.

C:S5.1.text: Customer needs centre on fire safety, energy performance, sustainability, regulatory compliance, build speed and long-term reliability.
